The elevated 99215 share appears in every complexity tier, not just among complex patients, and the sampled low-complexity 99215s include routine presentations: URI (C0038762), UTI (C0038754) and Z09 follow-ups (C0039322, C0039340). The complex-patient 99215s, such as C0039025 and C0039196, look plausible and partly explain the volume. Documentation cannot settle the question because only two 99215 claims came back. Both were documented as supported, but one (C0039124) is a high-MDM note for a one-condition patient with a rash code, which is worth checking for templated or cloned content. The 6 notes claiming moderate-or-higher data review with no lab or test line on the claim are weak evidence that some notes may not match the encounter. A reviewer should first request charts for the sampled low-complexity 99215 claims and compare note text across visits for cloning, before drawing any conclusion."}
